panels.detailed_description: Two side-by-side audiogram grids on the left half of the figure, each with a dark navy header bar containing Chinese characters for right or left and a date printed in year/month/day form (header text indicates 2024, 7, 25). The red right-ear grid uses circle markers at 125 and 250 Hz and triangle markers from 500 Hz to 8 kHz, joined by a line that falls from roughly 45 dB at the lowest frequencies to about 70 dB at 500 Hz and to roughly 80 to 85 dB at 4 kHz and 8 kHz; small bracket-like bone-conduction symbols sit above the curve near 250 to 2000 Hz. The blue left-ear grid uses X markers joined by a line staying between about 15 and 25 dB across 125 Hz to 8 kHz. Axes are frequency in Hz (125 to 8k) across the top and bottom and hearing level in dB (-10 to 120) on the vertical axis, with Chinese axis captions. Small rotated text between the grids resembles a record-number string and an examination timestamp; a small floating overlay with a Chinese character sits at the right edge of the blue grid. The letter A appears between the two grids.

First tracing labeled spontaneous nystagmus with the date 7/25/2024: a low-amplitude trace over roughly 1 to 19 s with small tick marks and a large step near 10 s. Then Dix-Hallpike test (7/25/2024) with Right and Left tracings (about 15 to 75 s and 110 to 151 s) showing jagged traces with red and blue tick marks and some thick black vertical bars. Each tracing has H SPV and V SPV labels at the right; legible ones are H SPV 4.3 and V SPV 1.9 (supine), H SPV 6.1 and V SPV -3.3 (left).
